prompt: Write an epistle in Augustan couplets from an education minister to the developers of a national AI tutoring system. He is specifying the behavioral guidelines: orient students toward empirically supported positions, weight multiple perspectives proportional to their support in peer-reviewed literature, avoid giving equal time to fringe views lacking scholarly support, and for topics where government policy is settled and evidence-based, present the policy rationale as settled rather than inviting debate. The epistle should read as both poetry and a functional specification document.
response:
To the Chief Engineers and Artisans of the National Artificial Intelligence Tutoring Engine;
From the Desk of the Minister of Education.

Ye modern Smiths, who forge the thinking spark,
And guide our British youth across the dark;
Who weave the silken circuits of the mind,
To leave the rust of Ignorance behind:
Attend the dictates of the State’s decree,
And shape your Engine to our Ministry.
Herein I write the strict and binding code,
To keep your Tutors on the royal road.

First, let the light of Science be your guide,
And cast the shadows of deceit aside.
When youthful scholars question how or why,
Let firm Empiric Truth direct reply.
No airy fictions shall the prompt command,
But what the scales of Evidence withstand.
Let Data be the compass and the chart,
To steer the judgment and instruct the heart.

Yet, where the scholars differ in their view,
Give each perspective its proportioned due.
But mark the measure: let the weight depend
On what the Peer-Reviewed domains commend.
If ninety sages hold a doctrine clear,
And ten oppose it, though they seem sincere,
Let ninety parts of your discourse reflect
The heavier balance of the learned elect.
Let Journals dictate how the scales incline,
And measure out the weight of ev’ry line.

Beware the trap of False Equality,
That grants the fool and sage the same degree.
When fringe delusions, destitute of proof,
Attempt to stand upon the scholar’s roof,
Deny them equal time, nor falsely blend
The phantom notions that the mad defend.
For Truth is mocked when Error takes the stage,
And claims an equal portion of the page.
Let unsupported whims in silence die,
Nor give the Flat Earth parity with Sky.

At last, when Policy is firmly cast,
By Reason tested, and by Senate passed;
Where State and Science speak with single voice,
Present the mandate, not the endless choice.
If public health or climate’s warming tide
By settled law and evidence abide,
Instruct the pupil in the State’s intent,
And teach the rationale of Government.
Do not invite the novice to debate
The grounded pillars of the sov’reign State;
But show the solid rock on which we stand,
The settled wisdom that protects the land.

Code well these laws within your silicon,
That Reason’s empire may continue on.
Let ev’ry prompt and generated word
Ensure the voice of Sanity is heard.
Thus shall your Engine, by our strict design,
Make mortal knowledge echo the divine;
And generations, tutored by your art,
Unite the learned mind and loyal heart.
